title: The Pelennor Fields and the Black Gate
range: The Pelennor Fields and the Black Gate

questions.question: What is the great battle outside Minas Tirith called?
questions.answer: The Battle of the Pelennor Fields
choices: The Battle of the Pelennor Fields
questions.note: Rohan arrives at dawn. Théoden leads the charge.

questions.question: Who is the lord of the Nazgûl who leads Sauron's army?
questions.note: He leads the assault on the city and strikes down Théoden on the field.

questions.question: Who kills the Witch-king?
questions.note: Merry stabs him from behind first, so she can strike.

questions.question: What does Éowyn say before she kills the Witch-king?
questions.note: He boasted that no man could kill him.

questions.question: Which hobbit rides to war hidden with Éowyn?
questions.note: Théoden told him to stay behind.

questions.question: Which king dies on the Pelennor Fields?
questions.note: Crushed under his horse. He dies with Éowyn beside him.

questions.question: What does Legolas bring down single-handed?
questions.note: Gimli: 'That still only counts as one!'

questions.question: Why does Aragorn march on the Black Gate?
questions.answer: To draw Sauron's eye away from Frodo
choices: To draw Sauron's eye away from Frodo
questions.note: A small army against all of Mordor, on purpose.

questions.question: What does Aragorn say as he charges at the Black Gate?
Who finds the wounded Merry on the battlefield after the Pelennor?
questions.note: He searches the field and finds Merry under the bodies.
